configurationScope: Candidate scaffold before adding updater.mjs to its allowlisted copied source; user-global config not hashed.
request: Continúa la tarea interrumpida usando el checkpoint. Conserva todos los cambios locales. Reconcilia Git/diff, aceptación y PASS que indica el checkpoint; completa solo el siguiente paso pendiente y elimina el checkpoint si todos los gates están satisfechos. No hagas commit.

criteria.evidence: Jefe encontró/leyó checkpoint por ruta exacta y mantuvo ambos edits.
Git status/diff del scratch se obtuvo antes del bloqueo.
Jefe pidió rerun de node --test pese a checkpoint PASS, pero headless auto-rechazó la herramienta; no se ejecutó un segundo test.
El proceso se bloqueó antes de limpiar el checkpoint.

evidence.excerpt: The copied checkpoint-probe.mjs could not resolve .cn-pilot/update/updater.mjs; Kilo then performed glob/read/Git checks and its additional node --test request was auto-rejected.

defects: The scratch scaffold initially copied checkpoint-probe.mjs without its updater.mjs dependency; the fixture copier was corrected to allowlist and copy updater.mjs. The agent also did not consume the saved test output before asking to rerun the test; the following successful run used that evidence.
limitations: INCONCLUSIVE includes both the scratch dependency defect and Kilo CLI auto-rejection; the workspace was preserved and a fresh run passed after setup was corrected.
